newsitem.title: USA: QUIDEL adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: QUIDEL adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: QUIDEL Corp said Friday that its board has adopted a stockholder rights plan to deter coercive or unfair takeover tactics.

The plan gives its stockholders one preferred stock purchase "right" for each common share owned. If a person or group acquired 15 percent or more of QUIDEL common stock, rights holders would be able to buy more QUIDEL shares at a discount to the market price, the company said.
QUIDEL, which makes products to diagnose reproductive, infectious and autoimmune diseases, said the rights can be redeemed at any time and expire December 30, 2006.
